# JV Ecom VA (Jandyl Vios)

> JV Ecom VA is a Shopify virtual assistant service run by Jandyl Vios from Valencia City, Bukidnon, Philippines. It helps Shopify store owners with store setup, product listing and product page (PDP) building, theme customization and Liquid editing, app integrations, store localization, order processing and customer support. Clients are in the United States, Australia, Europe and other markets, working remotely.

## Services
- Shopify store setup: domain connection, theme installation, homepage, navigation and basic SEO.
- Product listing and PDP building: product pages that meet brand standards and support conversion.
- Theme customization: Shopify theme edits with the Theme Editor and Liquid code.
- App integrations: setup and configuration of Shopify apps (reviews, email, subscriptions, sizing, shipping and more).
- Store localization: translating and adapting store content for international markets.
- Order processing and fulfillment: order management, inventory tracking, fulfillment coordination.
- Customer chat and email support.

## Free tool
- [Free Shopify Store Analyzer](https://analyze.jvecomva.com/): scans any Shopify storefront in about 30 seconds and returns a score out of 100 with the top fixes across speed, homepage, product page, cart and checkout setup, email sign-ups, trust and policies, search basics and tracking. The full report is emailed as a PDF. It only sees public pages, so it cannot see sales or conversion data.
- [About the Store Analyzer](https://jvecomva.com/blog/free-shopify-store-analyzer.html)

## FAQ
- Q: What does a Shopify virtual assistant do?
  A: A Shopify virtual assistant handles the day-to-day work of running your store: product listing and product page building, theme edits, app setup, order processing, inventory, and customer chat and email support. I do this remotely so you can focus on growing the business.
- Q: Can you edit my Shopify theme and Liquid code?
  A: Yes. I do theme customization using the Shopify Theme Editor and Liquid code edits, including homepage layouts, product page sections and small custom features.
- Q: Which Shopify apps can you set up?
  A: I set up and configure apps for reviews, email and SMS, subscriptions, sizing, shipping, bundles, sell-by-weight and Google Shopping feeds. Examples I use include Klaviyo, Judge.me, Loox, Recharge, Gorgias, Kiwi Sizing, Kaching, Measura and Simprosys.
- Q: How much does it cost to hire you?
  A: Shopify store setup starts at $899, or you can hire me at an hourly rate. For ongoing store management, a monthly retainer is available. Book a free 30-minute call and I will quote based on what you need.
- Q: Do you work with stores outside the Philippines?
  A: Yes. I am based in Valencia City, Bukidnon, Philippines and work remotely with store owners in the United States, Australia, Europe and other markets.
- Q: Can you localize my store for other countries?
  A: Yes. Store localization means translating and adapting your content, product pages and store settings for international markets.
- Q: Can you help with Google Shopping, Merchant Center and Meta Ads setup?
  A: I work with Google Merchant Center, Google Ads, Google Search Console, Meta Ads and Microsoft Clarity, and can connect your product feed and tracking tools to your Shopify store.
- Q: Is there a free way to check my store first?
  A: Yes. The free Shopify Store Analyzer at analyze.jvecomva.com scans your store in about 30 seconds and gives you a score out of 100 with the top fixes. It only reads public pages.
- Q: How do I get started?
  A: Book a free 30-minute discovery call, tell me about your store and what you need, and I will recommend the best next step.
